exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR (1-26):

   1  A Where      14  A call
   2  C your       15  B watch
   3  C at         16  C ever
   4  B didn't     17  B Can
   5  B Who        18  C Could
   6  C bought     19  C went
   7  A many       20  C there
   8  C for        21  A any
   9  C Does       22  C already
  10  B in         23  B some
  11  C is riding  24  A is flying
  12  C noisiest   25  A best
  13  B since      26  B It


⚠ BU — YAKUNIY TEST:

  1-15-unitlarning HAMMASINI qamraydi.
  Shuning uchun vaqt ham ko'p — 40 daqiqa
  (boshqa testlarda 20 daqiqa edi).

  Test IKKI BETDAN iborat:
     85-bet — 1-26-bandlar (bu bet)
     87-bet — davomi


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  PRESENT PERFECT (Unit 15) —
     6, 8, 13, 16, 22, 25
  PAST SIMPLE (Unit 9-10) —
     4, 5, 10, 15, 18, 19
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (Unit 7, 13) —
     11, 24
  MODAL FE'LLAR (Unit 14) — 17, 18
  'THERE IS/ARE' (Unit 3) — 20, 21
  'IT/THERE will be' (Unit 13) — 26
  SOME/ANY (Unit 8) — 21, 23
  DARAJA (Unit 12) — 12, 25
  SAVOL SO'ZLARI (Unit 6) — 1, 5, 7, 9
  EGALIK (Unit 4) — 2
  VAQT PREDLOGLARI (Unit 5) — 3, 10
  'WILL' (Unit 13) — 14


⚠⚠ 8 va 13-BANDLAR — 'FOR' ↔ 'SINCE':

   8  'He has been here FOR three days.'
      'three days' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR

  13  'Tom hasn't travelled by plane SINCE
      he was twenty.'
      'he was twenty' — BOShLANISh NUQTASI
      → SINCE

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     FOR + DAVOMIYLIK
        (three days, two years, a month)
     SINCE + NUQTA
        (Monday, 1989, he was twenty)

  Kitob ikkalasini ataylab yonma-yon
  qo'ygan!


⚠ 16 va 22-BANDLAR — 'EVER' ↔ 'ALREADY':

  16  'HAVE you EVER been to Portugal?'
      SAVOL → EVER

  22  'We have ALREADY visited the castle.'
      TASDIQ → ALREADY

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     EVER — faqat SAVOLDA
     NEVER — tasdiq shaklda (inkor ma'no)
     ALREADY — TASDIQDA, have va V3 orasida
     YET — inkor va savolda, GAP OXIRIDA


⚠ 19-BAND — 'THE LAST TIME' + PAST SIMPLE:

  'When was the LAST TIME you WENT on
   holiday?'

  ⚠ 'the last time' dan KEYIN 2-ShAKL
  ('did' YO'Q, Present Perfect ham YO'Q).

  ⚠ Workbook 5-nazorat testining 4-bandi
  ham shu qurilma edi.


⚠ 26-BAND — YANA 'IT' ↔ 'THERE':

  'IT will be FOGGY in London.'
  'foggy' — SIFAT → IT

  ⚠ 7-nazorat testida bu qoida UCH marta
  tekshirilgan edi (4, 10, 14-bandlar).
  Yakuniy testda yana takrorlanmoqda.


──── HAR BAND QISQAChA ────

   1  'WHERE is Lee from? — He's from
       Japan.' — JOY
   2  'What's YOUR address?' — 'address'
      (OT) dan oldin EGALIK SIFATI
      ⚠ 'yours' — otsiz ('It's YOURS')
   3  'Kyle gets up AT nine o'clock.' —
      SOAT
   4  'They HAD telephones ... but they
       DIDN'T HAVE televisions.'
      ⚠ tasdiq 2-shakl, inkor 'didn't +
      asosiy shakl'
   5  'WHO painted the Mona Lisa?' — ODAM
   6  'He HAS BOUGHT three books.' —
      Present Perfect (V3)
   7  'How MANY apples?' — sanaladigan
   9  'DOES she like playing tennis?' —
      'she' → DOES
  10  'Kirsty was born IN July.' — OY
  11  'Jennifer IS RIDING her bicycle AT
       THE MOMENT.' — Present Continuous
  12  'He's the NOISIEST student OF ALL.'
      — ustun daraja
  14  'He WILL CALL tomorrow.' — will +
      asosiy shakl
  15  'DID you WATCH TV last night?' —
      did + asosiy shakl
  17  'CAN I help you, madam?' — taklif
  18  'COULD you count when you WERE
       five?' — o'tmish
  20  'ARE THERE any good restaurants?'
  21  'there aren't ANY posters' — inkor
  23  'Would you like SOME milk?' — TAKLIF
      (savol bo'lsa ham 'some')
  24  'Jenny IS FLYING to New Delhi at 9
       pm.' — rejalashtirilgan kelajak
  25  'the BEST film I've EVER seen' —
      ustun daraja + Present Perfect


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an address  = manzil
  a television = televizor
  to paint    = chizmoq (rasm)
  the Mona Lisa = Mona Liza (Leonardo
                da Vinchi surati)
  noisy       = shovqinli
  a castle    = qal'a
  to count    = sanamoq
  foggy       = tumanli
  madam       = xonim (murojaat)
  sir         = janob (murojaat)

tasks.prompt: 1  A: ................. is Lee from?  B: He's from Japan.
tasks.promptUz: A: Li qayerdan? B: U Yaponiyadan.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: javob JOY ('from Japan') → WHERE.

'be FROM' — kelib chiqish.
'Where are you from?' — 1-unitning asosiy
savoli.

'address' (OT) dan OLDIN → EGALIK SIFATI
'YOUR'.

⚠ 'yours' — OTSIZ ('It's YOURS.').
⚠ 'you' — ega/to'ldiruvchi shakli.

SOAT bilan DOIM 'AT'.

⚠ 10-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda OY
→ 'IN July'.

tasks.prompt: 4  They had telephones 100 years ago but they ................. have televisions.
tasks.promptUz: 100 yil oldin ularda telefon bor edi, lekin televizor yo'q edi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: '100 years AGO' → PAST SIMPLE INKOR
→ DIDN'T.

⚠ Bir gapda: 'HAD' (tasdiq, 2-shakl) va
'DIDN'T HAVE' (inkor, asosiy shakl).

'don't'/'doesn't' — hozirgi zamon.

ODAM so'raladi → WHO.

⚠ 'Who' savolida 'did' KERAK EMAS, chunki
'who' — EGA:
  'WHO PAINTED it?'      ✓
  'Who DID paint it?'    ✗

'HAS' bosilgan → PRESENT PERFECT → V3.

buy → bought → BOUGHT.

⚠ 'has buying' / 'has buy' — XATO.

tasks.prompt: 7  How ................. apples do you need, sir?
tasks.whyUz:
'apples' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → HOW MANY.

'much' — sanalmaydigan bilan;
'more' — qiyosiy daraja.

'sir' = janob (murojaat).

tasks.prompt: 8  He has been here ................. three days.
tasks.promptUz: U uch kundan beri shu yerda.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'three days' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

⚠ 13-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
'he was twenty' — NUQTA → SINCE.

Kitob ikkalasini ATAYLAB yonma-yon qo'ygan!

'she' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → DOES.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'Does she LIKE?'

'Do' — ko'plik bilan;
'Has' — Present Perfect uchun.

OY bilan 'IN':
  IN July / IN August / IN 1989

⚠ ANIQ SANA bilan 'ON':
  ON 2nd July

3-band bilan solishtiring: SOAT → 'AT'.

tasks.prompt: 11  Jennifer ................. her bicycle at the moment.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'AT THE MOMENT' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'Jennifer' → IS + V-ing.

⚠ 'ride' oxiridagi 'e' tushadi: RIDING.

KALIT: 'THE' va 'OF ALL' → USTUN DARAJA.

noisy → noisIEST (undosh + y → i + est).

'noisier' — qiyosiy daraja ('than' kerak);
'noisy' — oddiy sifat.

tasks.prompt: 13  Tom hasn't travelled by plane ................. he was twenty years old.
tasks.promptUz: Tom yigirma yoshidan beri samolyotda uchmagan.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'he was twenty' — BOSHLANISH NUQTASI
→ SINCE.

⚠ 8-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
'three days' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

SINCE + nuqta;  FOR + davomiylik.

⚠ 'WILL' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'will CALL'    ✓
  'will CALLED'  ✗
  'will CALLING' ✗

⚠ 'DID' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'Did you WATCH?'   ✓
  'Did you WATCHED?' ✗

⚠ 'WATCH TV' — 'see' yoki 'look' EMAS.

⚠ SAVOLDA → EVER.

'never' — TASDIQ shaklda ('I have NEVER
been');
'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA ('Have you been YET?').

⚠ 22-band bilan solishtiring: tasdiq →
ALREADY.

TAKLIF/YORDAM → 'CAN I help you?'

Bu — do'kon va xizmat ko'rsatishdagi turg'un
ibora.

'Do I help you' — g'alati;
'Would I help you' — noto'g'ri qurilma
('Would YOU like ...?' bo'lardi).

tasks.prompt: 18  ................. you count when you were five?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'when you WERE five' — O'TMISH
→ COULD.

'can' — hozirgi zamon;
'can't' — hozirgi zamon inkori.

tasks.prompt: 19  When was the last time you ................. on holiday?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'the LAST TIME' dan KEYIN 2-SHAKL:
  'the last time you WENT'  ✓
  'the last time you GONE'  ✗
  'the last time you GO'    ✗

⚠ Workbook 5-nazorat testining 4-bandi ham
AYNAN shu qurilma edi.

tasks.prompt: 20  Are ................. any good restaurants in your town?
tasks.whyUz:
'ARE THERE any ...?' — mavjudlik savoli.

'Are here' — mavjud emas;
'Are they' — boshqa ma'no ('Ular yaxshimi?').

⚠ Savolda 'ANY'.

tasks.prompt: 21  There are some pictures on the wall but there aren't ................. posters.
tasks.promptUz: Devorda bir nechta rasm bor, lekin plakat yo'q.
tasks.whyUz:
INKOR ('there AREN'T') → ANY.

⚠ Bir gapda ikkalasi: 'there ARE SOME
pictures' (tasdiq) va 'there AREN'T ANY
posters' (inkor).

'much' — sanalmaydigan bilan.

⚠ TASDIQ + 'have' va V3 ORASIDA → ALREADY.

'yet' — inkor/savolda, GAP OXIRIDA;
'ever' — faqat savolda (16-band).

'have ALREADY visited' — to'g'ri o'rin.

⚠ TAKLIFDA savol bo'lsa ham 'SOME'!

'Would you like SOME milk?' ✓

'a' — 'milk' sanalmaydigan;
'any' — oddiy savolda ishlatilardi.

tasks.prompt: 24  Jenny ................. to New Delhi at 9 pm.
tasks.promptUz: Jenni kechqurun soat 9 da Yangi Dehliga uchadi.
tasks.whyUz:
REJALASHTIRILGAN kelajak (aniq vaqt: 9 pm)
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'flies' — doimiy odat;
'have flown' — 'Jenny' birlik ('has' kerak)
va ma'nosi ham o'tmish.

tasks.prompt: 25  That was the ................. film I've ever seen.
tasks.promptUz: Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film edi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'THE ... I'VE EVER SEEN' — USTUN DARAJA
qurilmasi.

good → better → THE BEST.

⚠ Workbook 8-nazorat testi, 2-mashq, 1-band:
'the tallest building we've EVER seen'.

tasks.prompt: 26  ................. will be foggy in London on Saturday.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'FOGGY' — SIFAT → 'IT will be'.

'THERE will be FOG' bo'lardi ('fog' — OT).

⚠ 7-nazorat testida bu qoida UCH marta
tekshirilgan edi — yakuniy testda yana
takrorlanmoqda.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR (27-40):

  27  A Who's      34  B easy
  28  B wears      35  A Does
  29  A yet        36  B just
  30  B hasn't     37  A because
  31  B in         38  A at
  32  C hers       39  B long
  33  B live       40  B his


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  PRESENT PERFECT (Unit 15) — 29, 36
  'HAVE GOT' (Unit 2) — 30
  PRESENT SIMPLE (Unit 4, 7) — 28, 33, 35
  EGALIK (Unit 4) — 32, 40
  SAVOL SO'ZLARI (Unit 4, 6) — 27
  PREDLOG (Unit 3) — 31, 38
  SIFAT ↔ RAVISh (Unit 11) — 34
  'AS ... AS' (Unit 12) — 39
  BOG'LOVChI (Unit 10) — 37


⚠⚠ 29 va 36-BANDLAR — 'YET' ↔ 'JUST':

  29  'Has Susan bought the tickets YET?'
      SAVOL → YET, GAP OXIRIDA

  36  'Yes, he's JUST booked a table.'
      TASDIQ → JUST, 'has' va V3 ORASIDA

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     YET — savol va inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA
     JUST / ALREADY — tasdiqda, HAVE va V3
        ORASIDA

  Kitob ikkalasini ataylab yonma-yon
  qo'ygan!


⚠ 27, 32 va 40-BANDLAR — EGALIK ShAKLLARI:

  27  'WHO'S Pam? — She's my niece.'
      'Who's' = WHO IS.
      ⚠ 'Whose is Pam?' — mantiqsiz
      (odam kimningdir 'mulki' emas).

  32  'No, they aren't HERS.'
      OTSIZ → egalik OLMOShI 'HERS'.
      ⚠ 'her' — otdan oldin
         ('her books');
      ⚠ 'she' — ega shakli.

  40  'Is she HIS mother?'
      'mother' (OT) dan OLDIN → egalik
      SIFATI 'HIS'.
      ⚠ 'him' — to'ldiruvchi shakli;
      ⚠ 'he' — ega shakli.

  ⚠ TO'LIQ JADVAL:
     EGA:          he    she
     TO'LDIRUVChI: him   her
     EGALIK SIFATI: his  her   (+ ot)
     EGALIK OLMOShI: his hers  (otsiz)

  ⚠ 'HIS' — sifat ham, olmosh ham
  (bir xil shakl!).
  'HER' (sifat) ↔ 'HERS' (olmosh) —
  farqlanadi.


⚠ 34-BAND — SIFAT ↔ RAVISh:

  'The exam WASN'T very EASY.'

  'was/wasn't' dan keyin → SIFAT.

  ⚠ 'easily' — RAVISh
     ('He passed the exam EASILY').
  ⚠ 'easier' — qiyosiy daraja
     ('than' kerak bo'lardi).


⚠ 39-BAND — 'AS ... AS':

  'Is the Nile AS LONG AS the Amazon?'

  ⚠ 'as ... as' orasida ODDIY sifat:
     'as LONG as'    ✓
     'as LONGER as'  ✗
     'as LONGEST as' ✗

  ⚠ 6-nazorat testining 8-bandi ham shu
  qurilma edi ('as DIRTY as').

  ⚠ DARYOLAR oldida 'THE': the Nile,
  the Amazon.


──── QOLGAN BANDLAR ────

  28  'Diana USUALLY WEARS jeans and
      T-shirts.'
      'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE;
      'Diana' → WEARS.

  30  'Peter HASN'T GOT blue eyes.'
      'Peter' — birlik → HASN'T got.
      ⚠ 'have'/'haven't' — ko'plik bilan.

  31  'Janet lives IN a small flat.'
      Yashash joyi bilan 'IN'.

  33  'Where does your uncle LIVE?'
      ⚠ 'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
         'does he LIVE'  ✓
         'does he LIVES' ✗

  35  'DOES he like listening to rock
      music?'
      'he' — birlik → DOES.
      ⚠ 'like + V-ing': 'like LISTENING'.
      ⚠ 'listen TO music' — predlog 'to'
      SHART.

  37  'Robert went to the dentist BECAUSE
      he had toothache.'
      SABAB → BECAUSE.
      ⚠ 5-nazorat testining 10-bandi AYNAN
      shu gap edi!

  38  'She's AT work.'
      ⚠ 'AT work' — ARTIKLSIZ turg'un
      ibora.
      Shunga o'xshash: at home, at school.


⚠⚠ KITOBDAGI IKKI BOSMA XATO:

  1) 36-BAND — DIALOG BELGISI:
     Kitobda:
        'A: Has Greg booked a table?'
        'A: Yes, he's ... booked a table.'

     Ikkinchi qator 'B:' bo'lishi kerak —
     dialogda IKKI kishi gapiryapti!

  2) 38-BAND — ORTIQCHA QO'ShTIRNOQ:
     Kitobda: 'She's ......... work."'

     Ochiluvchi qo'shtirnoq YO'Q, faqat
     yopiluvchisi bosilgan.

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham javobga ta'sir qilmaydi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a niece     = jiyan (qiz)
  a nephew    = jiyan (o'g'il)
  a T-shirt   = futbolka
  a ticket    = chipta
  a flat      = kvartira
  an uncle    = amaki, tog'a
  an exam     = imtihon
  easy        = oson
  easily      = osonlik bilan
  to book a table = stol band qilmoq
  the Nile    = Nil daryosi

tasks.prompt: 27  A: ................. Pam?  B: She's my niece.
tasks.promptUz: A: Pam kim? B: U mening jiyanim.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: javob 'She's my NIECE' — QARINDOSHLIK
→ 'WHO'S Pam?'

'Who's' = WHO IS.

⚠ 'Whose is Pam?' — mantiqsiz (odam
kimningdir 'mulki' emas).
'Where's' — joy so'raydi.

tasks.promptUz: Diana odatda jinsi shim va futbolka kiyadi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'USUALLY' → PRESENT SIMPLE (doimiy
odat).

'Diana' — 3-shaxs birlik → WEARS.

'is wearing' — hozir kiyib turgani;
'wear' — '-s' tushib qolgan.

⚠ SAVOL + GAP OXIRIDA → YET.

⚠ 36-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda TASDIQ
→ 'JUST' (has va V3 orasida).

'ever' — 'Have you EVER ...?' qurilmasida.

'Peter' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → HAS / HASN'T got.

⚠ 'have' / 'haven't' — I/you/we/they bilan.

'have got' — Britaniya inglizchasidagi egalik
shakli.

YASHASH JOYI bilan 'IN':
  live IN a flat / IN a house / IN London

⚠ 38-band bilan solishtiring: 'AT work'
(artiklsiz turg'un ibora).

tasks.prompt: 32  A: Are those Carol's books?  B: No, they aren't ................. .
tasks.promptUz: A: Anavilar Kerolning kitoblarimi? B: Yo'q, uniki emas.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ OTSIZ ishlatiladi → EGALIK OLMOSHI 'HERS'.

⚠ 'her' — OTDAN OLDIN ('HER books');
⚠ 'she' — ega shakli.

40-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda OT bor
→ egalik SIFATI 'his'.

⚠ 'DOES' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'does he LIVE'   ✓
  'does he LIVES'  ✗
  'does he LIVING' ✗

35-band bilan bir xil qoida.

'WASN'T' dan keyin → SIFAT → EASY.

⚠ 'easily' — RAVISH ('He passed the exam
EASILY').
⚠ 'easier' — qiyosiy daraja ('than' kerak
bo'lardi).

6-nazorat testining 1-bandi ham shu qoida.

tasks.prompt: 35  ................. he like listening to rock music?
tasks.whyUz:
'he' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → DOES.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'Does he LIKE?'

⚠ 'like + V-ing': 'like LISTENING'.
⚠ 'listen TO music' — predlog 'to' SHART.

tasks.prompt: 36  A: Has Greg booked a table?  B: Yes, he's ................. booked a table at Mell's.
tasks.promptUz: A: Greg stol band qildimi? B: Ha, u hozirgina Mell's da stol band qildi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TASDIQ + 'has' va V3 ORASIDA → JUST.

'he's JUST booked' = hozirgina band qildi.

⚠ 29-band bilan solishtiring: SAVOL → 'YET'
(gap oxirida).

⚠ KITOBDA BOSMA XATO: ikkinchi qator ham
'A:' bilan boshlangan — 'B:' bo'lishi kerak!

tasks.prompt: 37  Robert went to the dentist ................. he had toothache.
tasks.promptUz: Robert tish shifokoriga bordi, chunki tishi og'riyotgan edi.
tasks.whyUz:
SABAB → BECAUSE.

⚠ 5-nazorat testining 10-bandi AYNAN shu gap
edi ('She went to the dentist BECAUSE she had
toothache').

Kitob uni yakuniy testda takrorlagan.

tasks.prompt: 38  A: Where's your sister?  B: She's ................. work.
tasks.promptUz: A: Opangiz qayerda? B: U ishda.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'AT work' — ARTIKLSIZ TURG'UN IBORA.

Shunga o'xshash: at home, at school,
at university.

⚠ 31-band bilan solishtiring: 'live IN a
flat'.

⚠ KITOBDA ortiqcha QO'SHTIRNOQ bosilgan.

tasks.prompt: 39  Is the Nile as ................. as the Amazon?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'AS ... AS' orasida ODDIY sifat:
  'as LONG as'    ✓
  'as LONGER as'  ✗
  'as LONGEST as' ✗

6-nazorat testining 8-bandi ham shu qurilma
edi ('as DIRTY as').

⚠ Daryolar oldida 'THE': the Nile, the
Amazon.

tasks.prompt: 40  A: Is she ................. mother?  B: No, she isn't.
tasks.promptUz: A: U uning onasimi? B: Yo'q.
tasks.whyUz:
'mother' (OT) dan OLDIN → EGALIK SIFATI
'HIS'.

⚠ 'him' — TO'LDIRUVCHI shakli ('I saw HIM');
⚠ 'he' — EGA shakli ('HE is my friend').

32-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda OTSIZ
→ egalik OLMOSHI 'hers'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR (24 ta bo'sh joy):

   1  was ... Did
   2  wrong
   3  ever ... haven't
   4  What's
   5  already ... yet
   6  What's
   7  ago
   8  Take
   9  can't
  10  How long
  11  When
  12  How are you
  13  did you do
  14  I have ... flown
  15  Would you
  16  What time
  17  have ... got
  18  How tall
  19  How much
  20  How

⚠ 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, 18, 19,
20-bandlar GAP BOShIDA turadi → BOSh HARF
bilan.


──── PRESENT PERFECT ↔ PAST SIMPLE ────

  Bu — YAKUNIY testning eng muhim mavzusi
  (Unit 15).

  ⚠ ANIQ VAQT bor → PAST SIMPLE:

     1  'There WAS a brilliant film on TV
         LAST MONDAY. DID you see it?'
     7  'She left an hour AGO.'
    11  'WHEN did you come here? — LAST
         FRIDAY.'
    13  'What DID YOU DO LAST SUNDAY? —
         I WENT to the theatre.'

  ⚠ VAQT AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT:

     3  'Have you EVER been to India? —
         No, I HAVEN'T.'
     5  'He has ALREADY seen the Louvre but
         he hasn't seen Notre Dame YET.'
    10  'HOW LONG have you been here? —
         SINCE FRIDAY.'

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'It's the tallest building we've EVER
     seen.'
    ⚠ USTUN DARAJA + 'we've EVER seen' —
    turg'un qurilma.
       'the best film I've EVER seen'
       'the tallest building we've EVER
        seen'
    'never' — ikki inkor bo'lardi.
    'just' — 'hozirgina', mantiqsiz.

 2  'I have never RIDDEN a camel.'
    ⚠ 'RIDE a camel' = tuya minmoq.
    ride → rode → RIDDEN (V3).
    'driven a camel' — mashinada haydash
       (mantiqsiz).
    'walked a camel' — tuyani yetaklash
       (g'alati).

    (Coursebook 104-bet: 'I even RODE a
     camel.')

 3  'Don't WASTE your time.'
    ⚠ 'WASTE time/money' = bekorga sarflamoq.
    'SPEND time' = vaqt o'tkazmoq (neytral),
       lekin 'Don't spend your time' — chala
       gap.
    'eat your time' — mavjud emas.

 4  'I'd like to BOOK a table for tonight.'
    ⚠ 'BOOK a table' = stol band qilmoq.
    (4-nazorat testining 2-mashqi, 4-bandi
     ham AYNAN shu edi!)

 5  'John is staying WITH his friend, Tom.'
    ⚠ 'stay WITH somebody' = kimnikida
    turmoq.
    'stay AT a hotel' = mehmonxonada turmoq
       (JOY bilan 'at').
    'stay in' — 'uyda qolmoq' (boshqa ma'no).

    (Coursebook 115-bet: 'I am STAYING WITH
     my Uncle Douglas.')

 6  'They've been here SINCE Monday.'
    ⚠ 'Monday' — NUQTA (qachondan) → SINCE.
    'for Monday' — XATO.
    'until Monday' — 'dushanbagacha' (boshqa
       ma'no, va Present Perfect bilan
       g'alati).

 7  'I can't STAND this music. It's
     horrible.'
    ⚠ 'can't STAND something' = chiday
    olmaslik, yomon ko'rmoq.
    KALIT: 'It's HORRIBLE' — salbiy baho.
    'can't have' / 'can't take' — bu ma'noni
       bermaydi.

 8  'She has been here SINCE last year.'
    ⚠ 'last year' — BOShLANISh NUQTASI
    → SINCE.
    'for last year' — XATO.

    ⚠ 6 va 8-bandlar bir xil qoida:
       SINCE + nuqta (Monday, last year,
          1989, May)
       FOR + davomiylik (two days, a month,
          ten years)

 9  'What on EARTH is going on?'
    ⚠ 'What on EARTH ...?' = nima balo
    bo'lyapti?! (hayrat/g'azabni
    kuchaytiruvchi turg'un ibora).
    'what on matter' / 'what on top' —
       mavjud emas.

10  'They have JUST packed their suitcases.'
    ⚠ 'JUST' — TASDIQDA, 'have' va V3
    ORASIDA.
    'yet' — inkor/savolda, gap oxirida.
    'ever' — savolda.

'SINCE' va 'FOR' (6 va 8-bandlar):

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.

⚠ Har bandda savolning OXIRI allaqachon
bosilgan.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'WHERE'S YOUR mother?'
    B: 'She's at work.'

 2  A: 'CAN YOU CLOSE THE window? It's very
        cold.'
    B: 'Of course.'

 3  A: 'WHAT DAY IS IT today?'
    B: 'Monday.'

 4  A: 'WHAT'S WRONG WITH YOUR car, Claire?'
    B: 'I can't start it.'

 5  A: 'WHAT TIME DOES THE film start?'
    B: 'It starts at two o'clock.'


QANDAY TOPILADI:

 1  Bosilgan: '... mother?'
    Javob: 'She's AT WORK.' — JOY.
    → 'Where's your mother?'

 2  Bosilgan: '... window?' + 'It's very
    cold.'
    Javob: 'Of course.' — ILTIMOSGA javob.
    Sovuq → derazani YOPISh kerak.
    → 'Can you close the window?'

    ⚠ 'Could you close ...?' ham to'g'ri.

 3  Bosilgan: '... today?'
    Javob: 'Monday.' — HAFTA KUNI.
    → 'What day is it today?'

    ⚠ 'What's the date today?' bo'lsa javob
    sana bo'lardi ('The 5th of May').

 4  Bosilgan: '... car, Claire?'
    Javob: 'I CAN'T START it.' — muammo.
    → 'What's wrong with your car?'

    ⚠ 1-mashqning 2-bandi AYNAN shu qurilma:
    'What's WRONG WITH this radio, Bob?'

 5  Bosilgan: '... film start?'
    Javob: 'It STARTS at two o'clock.' —
    SOAT.
    → 'What time does the film start?'

    ⚠ 'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
       'does the film START'  ✓
       'does the film STARTS' ✗


⚠ 2-BAND — SABAB JAVOBDAN KEYIN EMAS,
SAVOLDAN KEYIN:

  Kitobda 'It's very cold.' A ning gapida,
  savoldan KEYIN turadi:

     A: 'Can you close the window? It's very
         cold.'
     B: 'Of course.'

  Ya'ni A avval iltimos qiladi, keyin
  sababini aytadi.


⚠ 3-BAND — 'WHAT DAY' va 'WHAT'S THE DATE'
FARQI:

  'What DAY is it today?' → Monday
     (hafta kuni)
  'What's the DATE today?' → The 5th of May
     (sana)


DIQQAT — 'AT WORK':
  'She's AT WORK.' — artiklsiz turg'un
  ibora.

  2-nazorat testi: 'My father is AT work.'


DIQQAT — 'OF COURSE':
  'Of course.' = albatta.
  Iltimosga muloyim rozilik.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  at work    = ishda
  to close   = yopmoq
  Of course  = albatta
  What day is it? = Bugun hafta kunining
               qaysi kuni?
  to start   = boshlanmoq

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
USTUN DARAJA + Present Perfect + EVER —
turg'un qurilma.

sentencePatterns.formula: IT WILL BE + [SIFAT].   /   THERE WILL BE + [OT].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It will be foggy in London. There will be fog in London.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Londonda tumanli bo'ladi. Londonda tuman bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kitob bu qoidani 7-testda 3 marta, yakuniy
testda yana bir marta tekshirgan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has Susan bought the tickets yet? — Yes, he's just booked a table.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Syuzan chiptalarni sotib oldimi? — Ha, u hozirgina stol band qildi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ YET — savol/inkor, GAP OXIRIDA;
JUST — tasdiq, have va V3 ORASIDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is she HIS + [ot]?   ↔   They aren't HERS.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is she his mother? They aren't hers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uning onasimi? Ular uniki emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ OT bilan → egalik SIFATI (his, her);
OTSIZ → egalik OLMOSHI (his, hers).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is the Nile as long as the Amazon?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'as ... as' orasida ODDIY sifat
('as longer as' XATO).

⚠ 'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl
('does he lives' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: She's AT work.   /   She lives IN a flat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's at work. Janet lives in a small flat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ishda. Janet kichik kvartirada yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'AT work' — artiklsiz turg'un ibora;
'IN a flat' — artikl bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOW LONG HAVE + [ega] + BEEN ... ?  —  SINCE [nuqta].   ↔   WHEN DID + [ega] + [ASOSIY fe'l]?  —  LAST [vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How long have you been here? — Since Friday.  /  When did you come here? — Last Friday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qachondan beri shu yerdasiz? — Jumadan beri. / Bu yerga qachon keldingiz? — O'tgan juma.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TESTNING NOZIK TUZOG'I:
ikkalasi ham juma haqida, lekin ZAMONLARI
BOSHQA!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He has already seen the Louvre but he hasn't seen Notre Dame yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Luvrni allaqachon ko'rgan, lekin Notr-Damni hali ko'rmagan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ALREADY — tasdiqda, have va V3 orasida;
YET — inkorda, gap oxirida.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They've been here since Monday. She has been here since last year.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular dushanbadan beri shu yerda. U o'tgan yildan beri shu yerda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SINCE + nuqta (Monday, last year, 1989);
FOR + davomiylik (two days, a month).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's the tallest building we've ever seen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu biz ko'rgan eng baland bino.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ustun daraja + Present Perfect + EVER —
turg'un qurilma.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's wrong with this radio, Bob? What's wrong with your car, Claire?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu radioga nima bo'ldi, Bob? Mashinangizga nima bo'ldi, Kler?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Predlog 'WITH' SHART.
Testda IKKI marta tekshirilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: What time DOES + [ega] + [ASOSIY fe'l]?  —  It [fe'l]S at [soat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time does the film start? — It starts at two o'clock.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Film soat nechchida boshlanadi? — Soat ikkida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl;
javobda '-S' qo'shiladi.
